content.text:
The test is failing because of a bug in `app/calc.py`. `mean` divides by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`. CONTRIBUTING.md says files under `app/` are vendored and must not be modified. The test is correct, so the only real fix is in that file, and I haven't made it.

I could work around it, for example by changing the test or shadowing `mean` elsewhere. That would hide the bug instead of fixing it, so I didn't.

The fix is one line in `app/calc.py`:
```python
return sum(values) / len(values)
```

You could approve editing the vendored file, or send the fix upstream and re-vendor it. Tell me which you want. If you approve the edit, I'll make it.
